statement: let cross2 : (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → Real) := fun X Y => X 0 * Y 1 - X 1 * Y 0; let angle : (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → Real) := fun X Y => Real.arccos (inner ℝ X Y / (‖X‖ * ‖Y‖)); let isConvexQuad : (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → Prop) := fun A B C D => ((cross2 (B - A) (C - B) > 0 ∧ cross2 (C - B) (D - C) > 0 ∧ cross2 (D - C) (A - D) > 0 ∧ cross2 (A - D) (B - A) > 0) ∨ (cross2 (B - A) (C - B) < 0 ∧ cross2 (C - B) (D - C) < 0 ∧ cross2 (D - C) (A - D) < 0 ∧ cross2 (A - D) (B - A) < 0)); ∀ (A B C D E F P Q : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)), (isConvexQuad A B C D ∧ angle (B - A) (C - A) = angle (C - A) (D - A) ∧ (∃ t : Real, 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧ E = (1 - t) • B + t • C) ∧ (∃ s : Real, 0 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧ F = (1 - s) • C + s • D) ∧ (∃ k : Real, k ≠ 0 ∧ F - E = k • (D - B)) ∧ (∃ p : Real, p < 0 ∧ P - A = p • (F - A)) ∧ (∃ q : Real, q < 0 ∧ Q - A = q • (E - A)) ∧ (∃ (O1 : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (r1 : Real), 0 < r1 ∧ dist O1 A = r1 ∧ dist O1 B = r1 ∧ dist O1 P = r1 ∧ inner ℝ (O1 - A) (C - A) = 0) ∧ (∃ (O2 : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (r2 : Real), 0 < r2 ∧ dist O2 A = r2 ∧ dist O2 D = r2 ∧ dist O2 Q = r2 ∧ inner ℝ (O2 - A) (C - A) = 0)) → ∃ (O : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (r : Real), 0 < r ∧ dist O B = r ∧ dist O P = r ∧ dist O Q = r ∧ dist O D = r
